authority: Owner selected Northbridge-only in-person sections on November 8, 2026
policy: When a needed course has no suitable official in-person offering in the selected term, create a clearly labeled Northbridge-only section using verified Old Westbury in-person meeting periods.
crossTermUse: If a historical term has no on-campus offerings, borrow verified in-person periods from the nearest available source term and use the documented target-term date range. These remain Northbridge-only sections with no official Old Westbury CRN.
